engine: Springs brand-tinted reveal — a full-bleed photo arrives under a brand-colour WASH that then tints to 0 ON the photo as the section scrolls into view, so every photo gets a brief 'brand-tint' beat before it resolves to full colour. Harvested from D_springs (Place->Jogging SEAM-07, f099->f106: heavy green tint -> lighter -> full colour).

measured_teardown.move: the section PINS full-screen on a full-bleed photo dipped in the brand colour; while pinned, a brand-colour overlay animates opacity wash%->0 ON THE WHOLE FRAME, so the tint drains off the full photo in place. The photo is solid the whole time; only the wash tints down. Scroll-scrubbed along the pin, reversible.
measured_teardown.cited: Springs SEAM-07 f099 (heavy green tint, full frame) -> f102 (lighter) -> f106 (full colour).

wash.what: starting wash opacity = the brand-tint strength. 1.0 = a full brand cover that tints down (zero see-through on any background); lower (e.g. 0.7) only on a brand-coloured backdrop.

fadeImage.what: false = the photo is solid under the wash (recommended; composite never thins, any background). true = also crossfade the image 0->1 under the wash — only safe on a backdrop of the brand colour.

pinFactor.what: pin length = innerHeight*pinFactor. The section pins full-screen (start 'top top') and the wash scrubs 1->0 across this span ON the full photo. 1.0 = one screen of scroll to fully clear the tint.

manageLenis.what: create+drive a Lenis (false if the page owns one).

entry: BrandOverlayCrossfade.init(target, opts) -> { trigger, lenis, render, refresh, destroy }. Markup: .boc-stage > .boc-img(img, z1) + .boc-wash(brand-colour layer, z2) + [.boc-content](z3). Wash colour set in CSS (var --boc-wash / background) = the brand/section colour.
law: Lenis 1.1.13 -> gsap.ticker -> ScrollTrigger.update; lagSmoothing(0); render(prog) PURE (wash opacity = wash*(1-prog)); PIN full-screen (start 'top top', end '+=innerHeight*pinFactor', pin:true, pinSpacing:true, scrub:true); opacity ONLY on wash (+ optional image); GPU layers; NO mix-blend / NO backdrop over the scrubbed surface; NO WebGL; reduced-motion/<=820px -> static (image full, wash 0). owns_pin TRUE -> ONE scroll owner per page.
gate_mode: normal — with fadeImage:false the media is always a solid filling the pinned viewport, only the brand wash tints down; no two-render overlap. blank/jank/fps standard.
proven: lab: OUR QUADRO render PINS full-screen and the green brand wash tints 1.0->0 ON the full frame while pinned (boc-ready, NOT boc-static). At wash 0.8 the photo is heavily dipped, 0.5 half-clear, 0 full colour — all at stageTop 0 (full-bleed), so the tint is seen across the WHOLE photo, not a strip. Gate PASS: blank 0.6%, seam 0%, coSolid 0, 59.9fps, jank 1/684.
